positiveEvidence.finding: UAU/Uattzy is the current brand formed from E-Shore, GASGAS and EnerMia; Uattzy operates as both CPO and eMSP.

Current FAQ says the Uattzy app/RFID displays the applied tariff per connector and possible additional costs; prices may vary with power, session duration and bay occupation. Some connectors require a EUR 15 payment pre-authorisation, which is not a charging fee.

Recent trade-press report states a new energy-only grid: app/RFID Quick EUR 0.57/kWh; Fast and Ultra Fast EUR 0.67/kWh; POS Quick EUR 0.61/kWh; POS Fast and Ultra Fast EUR 0.72/kWh, with per-minute charging removed.
May 2026 independent observatory identifies UATTZY as GASGAS/E-SHORE/ENERMIA and reports proprietary-app pricing, corroborating that the merged network is tariffed through Uattzy.

decision: Do not promote the reported July 2026 grid yet. First-party FAQ remains connector-specific and allows price variation; exact Quick/Fast/Ultra Fast class thresholds and deterministic applicability to every ESH/GAS/UTZ EVSE have not been established from first-party data.
blockage: Need first-party app/guest/ad-hoc payload mapping connector or EVSE to current tariff and power class, or an official Uattzy tariff publication giving exact class thresholds and universal applicability.
resumeCondition: Obtain current first-party Uattzy connector payload/API/app evidence or official tariff document with exact Quick/Fast/Ultra Fast thresholds and applicability.
negativePaths: Generic web tariff search is exhausted: it corroborates the July 2026 grid but does not establish first-party deterministic EVSE mapping.
confidence: high for corporate alias relationship; medium-high for candidate prices; insufficient for rankable direct EVSE coverage
